prompt:
Production Unity enemy Spitter sprite animation sheet. Reference defines exact identity silhouette/proportions, redraw the same creature's articulated action frames in that view. Matte dark brown rocky armor, warm pale gray-white sinew, amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera, soft upper-left light. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
EVERY frame orientation: LEFT profile facing screen left, nose at left edge of body and tail at right; keep this direction in EVERY pose. No turning body or changing camera angle in any row.
FOUR columns and 6 rows, EXACTLY 24 complete full creatures. PORTRAIT canvas width:height=4:6. Each sprite fits central 60% of equal cell, transparent 20% margins all sides. Full bodies MUST NOT touch/overlap other frames. Same body scale and ground anchor through all states. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Actual articulated joints and distinct foot placements; no duplicate still frames, no rotation-only or scaling-only simulation. Four consistent legs, one head, same plates. True transparent alpha0 empty pixels and holes. No background/shadows/floor, no text/labels/grid, no particles or projectile.
